high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "readingroomindia." The post features a photograph of a plate of rava idlis, which are a type of steamed rice cake made with semolina (rava) instead of rice. The idlis are neatly arranged on a metal tray lined with a red and white cloth. The caption accompanying the image provides historical context about MTR Foods, a popular restaurant chain in India.
